theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M Γ : Set (Rn N)) (θ : Rn N → ℝ) (x : Rn N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n] → NullMeasurableSet Γ μHE[n] → μHE[n] Γ < ∞ → IsPositiveLocallyIntegrableWeight n M θ → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n Γ x P → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in (M \ Γ) ∩ Metric.ball x ρ, |θ z| ∂μHE[n]) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * (μHE[n] ((Γ \ M) ∩ Metric.ball x ρ)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in M ∩ Γ ∩ Metric.ball x ρ, |θ z - θ x| ∂μHE[n]) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P
